Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study uses a SILAC-labeled internal standard for relative quantification across multiple LCL samples. Although the text mentions 'non-synonymous SNPs near acetylation sites' in the context of biological enrichment analysis, the PRIDE metadata explicitly states 'No PTMs are included in the dataset', and no PTM enrichment was performed during sample preparation. Therefore, no PTM modifiers are applied.

scope: LCLs were washed in PBS three times and then lysed using the UPX Universal Protein Extraction Kit (Expedeon Inc., San Diego, CA, USA).
Complete label incorporation was verified by analyzing the protein lysate from the labeled LCL alone by high-resolution LC-MS/MS.
